title: 第23章 你都叫兄弟了那还说啥了第24章 工作的时候称职务
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
孙悟空的眼睛眨了眨，颇为意动。
苏元心中一凛，知道戏肉到了，能否成功就在此一举，
说时迟那时快，他猛地画了一张大饼，扔给孙悟空。
“师弟，你可知此次招安，与上次那‘弼马温’有着云泥之别！
你这是直接被纳入天庭最高级别的‘管培选调’体系！”
见悟空面露疑惑，他立刻用更直白的话解释道：
“什么意思？就是说，你是玉帝陛下和天庭中枢亲自认定的、最重要的储备干部！
是要放进‘顶级人才池’里重点培养的！
只要稍加时日，积累些宝贵资历，未来前途不可限量！”
“以师弟你的根脚和能耐，三千年足以主政一方洞天福地，五千年！
五千年绝对成就一方大帝尊位！
比你如今这个有名无实、无兵无权的‘齐天大圣’虚职，不知道高到哪里去了！”
悟空兴奋得抓耳挠腮，眼中金光乱闪。
“师兄……这……这是否有点过于恩宠了？俺老孙何德何能……”
苏元立刻把胸脯拍得山响：
“你都叫兄弟了，那还说啥了。”
他凑近一步，压低声音。
“你赶紧回去收拾收拾，挑些得力心腹，三日后，就跟我们上天述职！”
苏元心里暗自盘算，
【趁着这三天，正好将船队的物资找个渠道发卖掉，又是一笔灵石入账。

悟空闻言，喜得一跃而起，猛地跳下石座，搓着手道：
“好师兄！
俺老孙这便去准备！”
他走了两步，又折返回来，从耳中掏出两坛香气四溢的酒酿，
“师兄，俺这花果山自酿的猴儿酒，虽比不上天庭御酿，也别有风味，你带着路上喝！”
说罢，不由分说将两坛美酒塞到苏元怀中，头也不回扬长而去。
苏元无奈摆手。
“哎，兄弟，太性情了，这扯不扯。”
回到天舟上，听闻孙悟空已经答应上天，太白喜不自胜，抚着长须连连点头：
“好！
好哇！
苏元，我早就知道，你办事，我放心！”
content_en:
Sun Wukong blinked his eyes, quite moved.
Su Yuan's heart trembled, knowing that the drama was about to happen, and whether he could succeed or not depended on this.
Soon after he said it, he suddenly drew a big cake and threw it to Sun Wukong.
"Junior brother, do you know that this recruitment is completely different from the 'Bima Wen' last time!
You are directly included in the highest-level ‘management training and selection’ system in Heaven! "
Seeing Wukong's doubts, he immediately explained in more straightforward terms:
"What do you mean? That is to say, you are the most important reserve cadre personally recognized by His Majesty the Jade Emperor and the Central Committee of Heaven!
They are to be put into the ‘top talent pool’ for key training!
As long as you give it a little time and accumulate some valuable qualifications, your future will be limitless! "
"Junior brother, with your foundation and ability, three thousand years is enough to rule a cave heaven and paradise, and five thousand years!
Five thousand years will definitely achieve the throne of a great emperor!
I don’t know how much higher you are than the ‘Monkey King’ you are now, who is in name only, has no soldiers and no power, and holds an empty position! "
Wukong was so excited that he scratched his head and his eyes were filled with golden light.
"Senior brother...is this...is this a bit too much favor? How can I, the old grandson He De..."
Su Yuan immediately slapped his chest loudly:
"You've already called me brother, so what else is there to say?"
He took a step closer and lowered his voice.
"Hurry back and clean up, pick some capable confidants, and report your work to us in three days!"
Su Yuan secretly calculated in his heart,
[I took advantage of these three days to find a way to sell the fleet's supplies, and another amount of spiritual stones were recorded.
When Wukong heard this, he jumped up with joy, jumped off the stone seat, rubbed his hands and said:
"Good senior brother!
I, Lao Sun, will prepare now! "
He took two steps, then turned back and took out two jars of fragrant wine from his ears.
"Senior brother, although the monkey wine I brewed in Huaguoshan is not as good as Tianting Imperial Brewing, it still has a unique flavor. You can drink it on the road!"
After that, he couldn't help but put the two jars of wine into Su Yuan's arms and walked away without looking back.
Su Yuan waved helplessly.
"Hey, brother, it's too temperamental. This is nonsense."
Returning to the sky boat, Taibai was overjoyed when he heard that Sun Wukong had promised to go to heaven. He stroked his long beard and nodded repeatedly:
"Okay!
Wow!
Su Yuan, I have known for a long time, I can rest assured that you will do things! "
